Name: Chest Freezer (for Custom Chest Types)
Author: agaremy
Description:
As many of my farmer friends would attest, a bustling agricultural operation would certainly involve an industrial freezer for long-term storage! Though I'm staunchly Team Community Center, I was inspired by the decorative freezers in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11793]Joja's Extended Cellar[/url] to create a placeable version (purchaseable at the carpenter's) capable of holding a large quantity of items. Thanks to aedenthorn for the extremely helpful sample content pack available for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7755]Custom Chest Types[/url], which even a brand-new modder like myself was able to adapt for what I had in mind!

I'm aware the 72-item capacity makes the rows look funny; the page for CCT suggests that this is fixed by installing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7431]Expanded Storage[/url], though it's still looking weird to me so no promises. Still, it should be completely functional either way. If you don't want to install Expanded Storage, feel free to edit the "capacity" entry in the content.json file to 36 or lower and change the "true" to "false" in the dependency entry in manifest.json -- I just felt that such a large object should pack a substantial storage punch!

Finally, though the item is 4 tiles wide, the framework only recognizes the "chest" aspect at the far left, so be sure to be standing adjacent to where you want the left corner to be placed when trying to set it down. Similarly you can only open the freezer from the left side as well.﻿

Other mods visible in the screenshots include: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7109]Boogie's Cellar Extension[/url] (with a few map edits I made to add trapdoors to other farm buildings); [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5767]Flower Meads[/url]; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15835]Cave Carrot Crop[/url]; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10386]Just Luck Mod[/url]; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14055]Cellar Door[/url]﻿ (ladder on the left side); [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6210]Flowery Straw Hat[/url]; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16760]Seasonal Leaf Cursor[/url]; and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables[/url].

Thanks to everyone for all their hard work making these frameworks and providing so much documentation for how to make them function!
